audience: online sellers and shipping teams who ship parcels with EasyPost

useCases.title: Check where packages are
useCases.text: The AI lists trackers by tracking code or carrier and reads one tracker with its current status and tracking history. You see which parcels are still in transit.

useCases.title: Review recent shipments and their tracking codes
useCases.text: The AI lists shipments, most recent first, and opens one to see its rates, tracking code and purchased label. You get an overview of what was shipped.

useCases.title: Create and verify a delivery address
useCases.text: The AI creates and verifies a US or international address and returns whether it is deliverable, with the normalized fields. It also reads saved addresses.

useCases.title: Create a shipment and compare its rates
useCases.text: The AI creates a shipment from an address pair and a parcel and lists the rates of all enabled carriers. It does not buy a label, so you can compare prices first.

useCases.title: Buy a label or refund one
useCases.text: The AI buys a label for a shipment at the rate you pick, which charges the account, or asks for a refund of a bought label. The carrier decides on the refund.
